title: Independent Qualification of F-MR33 Restricted DIVDRA Runtime Binding

candidate.materialization: git show exact owner closeout into build-only path; qualification branch carries no candidate production source

qualification_question: Does the exact F-MR33 candidate, without hidden state or backend capture, faithfully materialize the already-qualified DIVDRA node projection into the existing runtime drainage sink seam for the restricted single-level positive scope?

independent_matrix.valid_runtime_cases: independently generated combinations of node counts, layer geometries, conductivities, anisotropy, drain spacing, groundwater views and positive scalar transfers
failure_classes: nonzero transfer at or below restricted 1e-10 magnitude
independent_matrix.repeatability: fresh-target repeated calls must publish identical rows
independent_matrix.consumer_composition: current b110 source/sink provider must consume the published row unchanged as drainage sink

runtime_acceptance: qualification branch has zero src/ and zero reference/ delta from clean_base
for each admitted independent case, binding status is OK and target shape is exactly 1 x active_nodes
for identical explicit inputs, published row is bit-identical to the canonical qualified process output
binding introduces zero additional mass error: ordered sum of published row is bit-identical to ordered sum of direct process row
source/sink provider sees exactly the published drainage row as positive sink when other sinks/sources are zero
failure paths publish nothing and propagate non-OK process status
preallocated target remains byte-for-byte unchanged and process is not evaluated
repeated calls with fresh targets are deterministic and show no persistent process state
candidate source contains no committed-state snapshot, backend import, HeadCalc internal, Jacobian mutation, file I/O, MODFLOW assumption or configurable tolerance
O0 and O2 verifier output byte-identical
mass_policy: No configurable or physical mass tolerance. The runtime seam is accepted only if it copies the canonical process row exactly and therefore introduces no additional mass discrepancy.
not_qualified: fully implicit drainage response derivatives or Jacobian assembly
committed-versus-trial hydraulic-view provenance policy outside this explicit-input binding
next_if_pass: separate F-CI canonical admission of the exact qualified F-MR33 runtime blob
